## Ongoing Activities

### I-ADOPT related Specifications
- Identifying constraint types for potential full FAIR representation
- Reviewing decision trees and patterns and their representations
- Specify mappings between existing standards
- Define SPARQL queries to find existing variables across Semantic Artifact Catalogs
- Build a system to constrain units based on the properties

### I-ADOPT related Services
- Include patterns in the workflow to improve the output of the LLM-supported Service
- Add provenance trails of the outcomes of the LLM-Service and make the accessible online

### I-ADOPT Publications
- From Scientific Variables to Knowledge Graphs: The I-ADOPT Benchmark, Semantic Web Journal: Baseline paper for LLM experiments; Authors: Magagna, B., Rastegar, A., González Guardia, E., Berrio, C., Chalk, S., Schindler, S., Gómez-Pérez, J. M., Lorenz, C., Kumar, S., Garijo, D.
- I-ADOPT Recommendations 2nd version with a specific focus on FAIR aspects

## Future Developments

### I-ADOPT related Specifications
- Unpack Constraints by modelling them as observations
- Resolve concepts used more than one time in different description components using paths
- Provide SHACL definitions for property patterns
- Enhance I-ADOPT Description quality Through LLM-guided researcher dialogues
- Define how nesting of VariableSets can work
- Represent dependencies between variables
- Compile I-ADOPT specification for the Observation, Measurement, and Sample OGC Standard
- Compile Context Profile with I-ADOPT decomposition approach aligned with the CDIF Data Description and Data Structure Profiles 

### I-ADOPT related Services
- Enhance I-ADOPT Visualizer to enable machine-interpretable Constraints
- Improve I-ADOPT Catalog to include a publishing workflow
- Improve I-ADOPT Catalog to enable search based on the description components
- Improve I-ADOPT Catalog to enable hierarchical visualization based on their SKOS relations (broader/narrower)

### I-ADOPT Publications
- Implementation guidelines
- A paper demonstrating practical benefits of I-ADOPT, highlighting how machine-actionable variable definitions significantly accelerate complex data mapping
- I-ADOPT Adoption Stories
